title: Create 2D Buttonhole Measurement
content: ### Objective View buttonhole position from the pattern outline with 2D measurements (ver2.5.0). ### Location Object Browser ▶ Buttonhole Property Editor ▶ 2D Measurements ▶ To Center ### Operation 1. Select a buttonhole with Select/Move Button tool in the 3D toolbar. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser ▶ Buttonhole Property Editor ▶ 2D Measurements ▶ To Center 3. Select the desired 2D measurement options of the Left/Right/Up/Down. → The 2D measurement is now being displayed or hidden accordingly.
content_description: This web page provides instructions for viewing and managing the buttonhole position and 2D measurements in the buttonhole property editor.

title: FABRIC PHYSICAL PROPERTIES: Physical Property Detail Setting
content: Adjust each item of the detailed settings to express Physical Properties not included in Presets. Each property mutually affects one another and a Garment's physical property is expressed by combination of all detailed property values. ※ Note: * The property details are adjustable with the scroll bar or by entering in actual measurement values. * Scroll Bar [0~99]: This is better input method when the constant value is far too enormous. To reduce this inconvenience, the most commonly used Physical Property is split into 99 stages. * Constant Value [0~1000000000] This is better input method when setting far more accurate Physical Properties than the scroll bar method above.
content_description: Customize and fine-tune the detailed settings of physical properties for garments, allowing for precise adjustments that reflect their unique characteristics beyond preset options.

title: Duplicate as Buttonhole to Symmetric Pattern
content: ### Objective Duplicate buttons as buttonholes, or buttonholes as buttons, to its Symmetric Pattern. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Button ▶ Select/Move Button 3D Toolbar ▶ Select/Move Button ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Button ▶ Select/Move Button 3D Toolbar ▶ Select/Move Button 2. Click on the button or buttonhole to be duplicated to its Symmetric Pattern. → The selected button or buttonhole is highlighted in yellow. 3. Right-click on the selected button or buttonhole. → The right-click pop-up menu appears. 4. Depending on the selected item, select Duplicate as Button to Symmetric Pattern or Duplicate as Buttonhole to Symmetric Pattern. → The selected button or buttonhole is duplicated as a buttonhole or button, depending on the selected item, to its Symmetric Pattern.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for duplicating buttons and buttonholes to their Symmetric Pattern using the 3D Toolbar.

title: Show 3D Shadow

title: ANIMATION MODE: Delete Animation
content: ### Objective Delete loaded Avatar Motion files or recorded Garment Animations. ### Location Animation Mode ▶ Animation Editor ▶ Animation Right-click Menu ▶ Delete ### Operation 1\. Follow the indicated guideline below: Animation Mode ▶ Animation Editor ▶ Animation Right-click Menu ▶ Delete → The selected Animation is now being deleted. ※ Note: Deleted Animation frames cannot be restored by 'Undo'.

title: Segment Topstitch
content: ### Objective Create a Segment Topstitch (Patterns or Internal Shapes that are split by points). ### Location Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Topstitch ▶ Segment Topstitch 2D Toolbar ▶ Segment Topstitch ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Topstitch ▶ Segment Topstitch 2D Toolbar ▶ Segment Topstitch 2. Click on a segment to create a Topstitch. → The Segment Topstitch is created on the selected segment with being highlighted. ※ Note: * Click-and-drag in the 2D window to encompass all segments where Topstitches to be applied. Topstitches appear on all selected segments (ver3.2.0). * Use lasso selection to select Pattern Outlines and Internal Lines where Topstitches should be created on (ver3.2.0). * OBJ Topstitches temporarily disappear when the Simulation is activated, but they appear again when the Simulation is deactivated (ver3.2.0).

title: 2D Environment setting: Fix Grid Display
content: ### Objective This option is to fix the grid spacing regardless of the zoom of the 2D window, which makes it easier to recognize the magnification or reduction of the 2D window. ### Location Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on the 2D window) ▶ 2D Pattern Window Properties ### Operation 1\. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on the 2D window) ▶ 2D Pattern Window Properties → The properties related to the 2D window appear in the Property Editor. 2\. Find and toggle on/off Grid ▶ Show 2D Grid ▶ Auto Adjust Distance with Zoom. → When the Auto Adjust Distance with Zoom option is activated, the grid zooms in and out automatically as the 2D window zooms in and out. On the other hand, when the Auto Adjust Distance with Zoom option is deactivated, the grid is fixed and maintains its assigned size. ※Note: The Auto Adjust Distance with Zoom option is activated by default.
content_description: This web page provides instructions for fixing the grid spacing in a 2D window, allowing users to easily recognize changes in magnification regardless of zoom levels.

title: Automatically Create Fitting Suit at Import
content: ### Objective Automatically generate a Fitting Suit for a custom bipedal avatar at import. * * * ### Location Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Import ▶ OBJ/FBX ▶ **Auto Create Fitting Suit**. **** ### Operation 1. Select the tool/menu indicated above under "Location". 2. Select either OBJ or FBX file format for import. 3. Navigate to the file location for a custom bipedal avatar (two arms, two legs, no tail) in either A-Pose or T-Pose, and double-click on the file name. → The Import OBJ/FBX pop-up Window appears. 4. Make sure the **Load Type** is set to **Open** and the **Object Type** is set to **Avatar**. 5. Check the option box next to **Auto Create Fitting Suit** 6. Click on **OK**. → The Avatar is imported into the scene and a Fitting Suit is automatically created in the process.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide to automatically generate a fitting suit for custom bipedal avatars during the import process.

title: Marvelous Designer Standalone License Transition
content: **Effective Date:** December 2, 2025 This document outlines the discontinuation of the Marvelous Designer Standalone license and establishes the transition procedures for all existing Standalone license holders. As of the Effective Date, the Marvelous Designer Standalone Online license will be retired and will no longer be available for purchase. ## **Continued Support for Existing Licenses** All existing Standalone licenses will continue to be fully supported and will retain all current features until their expiration date. #### ## **Transition Offer for Annual Standalone Licenses** To facilitate a seamless transition, a transition offer is being provided for a grace period to all Annual Standalone license holders. * **Offer Period:** The grace period for this offer is from the Effective Date until **June 30, 2026**. * **Transition Option:** During this period, users can transition to a Network Online license at the same annual renewal price of **$1900 USD per license**. * **Automatic Upgrade:** Upon renewal, the user’s existing Annual Standalone license will be automatically upgraded to a Network Online License for the remainder of its current term, in addition to the new annual term. #### ## **Transition for Monthly Standalone Licenses** * All existing Monthly Standalone license holders will be seamlessly transitioned to the new Subscription License * This license shall provide the same feature to that of the current Monthly Standalone License without the node-lock system. #### ## **Table of Enterprise Licenses as of Dec. 2** **Name** | **Price** | **Description** | **OS** ---|---|---|--- ENTERPRISE MONTHLY SUBSCRIPTION | $199/month | Full MD experience with limited Userpool feature Only available via subscription on the website | Windows, Mac ENTERPRISE ANNUAL NETWORK | $2,000/year | Full MD experience with Userpool feature | Windows, Mac ENTERPRISE LINUX | $2,300/year | Full MD experience with Userpool feature | Linux only *The Userpool feature simplifies user account management, allowing you to easily assign purchased licenses to multiple end-user IDs. ([Userpool Manual](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358149827609-User-Pool-Manual))
content_description: This webpage provides important information regarding the discontinuation of the Marvelous Designer Standalone license, outlining transition procedures, continued support for existing licenses, and special offers available to license holders ahead of the change.

title: Troubleshooting with HASP Driver Errors
content: ## **The Latest HASP driver download (updated June 2022)** * [Mac version](https://cdn.clo3d.com/HASP/Sentinel_Runtime_94691.tar) * [Linux version](https://cdn.clo3d.com/HASP/aksusbd-8.31.1.tar) * [Windows version ](https://cdn.clo3d.com/HASP/haspdinst_8_31.exe) ## **Sentinel HASP Driver Errors on Windows** ### **Objective** The Sentinel HASP Diver is automatically installed with the software, but it fails occasionally. Please download and install the Sentinel HASP Driver which is suitable for your operating system. ### **Operation** **Installing Sentinel Driver on Windows** 1\. Download the driver from the link below. [Windows HASP Driver Download](https://s3.amazonaws.com/s3.md.web.upload/newmdweb/helpcenter/installer/haspdinst_8_31+\(2\).exe) 2\. Enter "CMD" in 'Windows Start Button + Run (R)' to install the driver. 3\. Drag the downloaded haspdinst.exe file and put it on the CMD window to automatically register the corresponding path as shown underlined below. Enter "-i" behind the automatically entered path and press 'Enter' on keyboard to install. ![0.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438481245593) 4\. Access to [http://localhost:1947](http://localhost:1947/_int_/ACC_help_index.html) and check to see if the following screen appears to see if the HASP Driver has been successfully installed. If the following screen appears, then installation is successful. ![1.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438509264281) 5\. If the following error occurs, the HASP Driver must be deleted and reinstalled. ![2.jpg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438526236825) ![3.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438526436121) #### **Deleting Sentinel Driver on Windows** 1\. Download the driver from the link below. [HASP Driver Download](https://s3.amazonaws.com/s3.md.web.upload/newmdweb/helpcenter/installer/haspdinst_8_31+\(2\).exe) 2\. Enter "CMD" in 'Windows Start Button + Run (R)' to delete the driver. ![4.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438482016025) 3\. Drag the downloaded haspdinst.exe file and put it on the CMD window to automatically register the corresponding path as shown underlined below. Enter "-purge -r" behind the corresponding path and press 'Enter' on keyboard to delete. ![5.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438482218649) 4\. After the driver has been successfully deleted, refer to reinstall the driver. ## Sentinel HASP Driver Errors on MAC ### **Objective** The Sentinel HASP Diver is automatically installed with the software, but it fails occasionally. Please download and install the Mac OS Sentinel HASP Driver. ### **Operation** #### Installing Sentinel Driver on Mac * Sentinel Driver for Mac [Download](https://s3.amazonaws.com/s3.md.web.upload/newmdweb/helpcenter/installer/Sentinel_Runtime.tar) 1\. Please remove all the dongle keys inserted into the Mac for installation to be done correctly. 2\. Mount "Sentinel_Runtime.dmg" (ver 21.0 Build 77815) ![9.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438527013401) 3\. Double-click the Install Sentinel Runtime Environment icon. 4\. Please allow the 'hasplmd' application to accept incoming network connections (this message may not appear). 5\. Access to [http://localhost:1947](http://localhost:1947/_int_/ACC_help_index.html) 6.If you are unable to connect to the URL, try again after 10 seconds later. If it still does not work, reboot and connect again. If the solutions above do not work, please go back to the first step and check again. ![6.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438527230489) *If you click Diagnostics, License Manager Version appears with newly installed version; ver 21.0 Build 77815 (Version information of 21.0 Build 77815 appears as this in Diagnostics). ![7.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438482949657) 7\. Insert Dongle key into USB port. 8\. If the Dongle key appears in 'Sentinel Keys', the installation is successfully done. ![8.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438527554841) #### Reinstalling Sentinel on Mac 1\. Please remove all the dongle keys from USB port. 2\. Mount "Sentinel_Runtime.dmg" with version of "ver 21.0 Build 77815". ![9.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438527013401) 3.Double-click Uninstall Sentinel Runtime Environment. ![10.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438483463065) 4\. Click Uninstall. ![11.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438483624985) 5.If the un-installation is done normally, the dialog above appears. Please press OK button and then click Quit. 6.Reboot your Mac. 7.Install Sentinel Driver. Please refer to the following method; *If you don't follow the guideline, you may not be able to find Dongle keys inserted into your PC or other PCs. Also the other PCs may not be able to find your Dongle key. #### #### Sentinel Driver Known Bugs * Sentinel LDK Protection System Error : invalid XML scope (36) Normally occurred when operating in Marvelous Designer modelist network dongle 1.4.14.7701 (Enveloped with Sentinel LDK 6.4 version or before 6.4). * Occurs with the following conditions: → Network Dongle key (not a local Dongle key) → Marvelous Designer Modelist Network with 2.1.44 or later version. (Enveloped with Sentinel LDK 7.1) → The Dongle key is inserted into another PC. → The version of Sentinel Driver is 13.20 in your Mac. → Operates normally after reinstalling with Mac Sentinel Driver ver 16.0. * If multiple Sentinel Drivers are mounted, the software is unable to find virtual files. If a driver is already mounted, please demount(or eject) it and mount new driver. * Sentinel Driver starts to operate in a few seconds. On occasion, it does not start. In that case, please reboot your PC. * All the Dongle keys should be removed when uninstalling Sentinel Driver. ![12.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438483927577)
content_description: This page provides the latest downloads and installation instructions for the Sentinel HASP driver for Windows, Mac, and Linux, along with troubleshooting tips for common errors.

title: Copy/Paste

Right Click Pop-Up Menu (On Pattern or Internal Line) ▶ Copy (Ctrl+C) or Paste (Ctrl+V) → Clone of the Pattern follows along the mouse cursor. 3. title: Change Pose by OBJ Morphing
content: ### Objective Vertex Morphing has a merit of maintaining avatar's final form without any distortion. However on the other hand, garments may fall off during the morphing process, especially when there is a large difference between the first and the last pose as the pose changes by the minimum distances between points in the avatar rather than the units of avatar joints. Therefore if a big difference between the poses, it is recommended to create an OBJ file for interim pose and morph stage-by-stage. If it is inconvenience, change pose by another method, Change Pose by Using Collada. ### Operation 1. After dressing an avatar in CLO, at least two files are required to change poses such as T-pose avatar and another avatar in desired pose. Export both of the files in OBJ format. To find export method in details, check 3D File (OBJ) Import/Export for the reference. 2. Click File ▶ Import ▶ OBJ and select the T-pose OBJ file of the previously exported avatar. Click OK on the option dialogue to load the avatar. 3. Put the garments on top of the loaded avatar. 4. Click File ▶ Import ▶ OBJ Load as Morph Target the previously saved avatar with another pose. Set the 'Morphing Frame Count' in the option dialogue, then click OK. 5. The Simulation button automatically activates and the avatar pose slowly changes according to the set frame count. The garment also starts simulating in accordance with the change. Adjust garments if necessary, after the final pose simulation.
content_description: This webpage provides a step-by-step guide for effectively using Vertex Morphing to maintain garment integrity during avatar pose transitions in CLO.

title: Retopology (ver 5.1.0)
content: ### ### ### ### ### Objective Draw topology lines on a pattern and create a new mesh. ### **Create** ### Location 3D/2D Window Tool Bar▶ Topology tool ### Operation 1. Follow the path indicated in Location above. 2. With Topology tool selected, patterns will be displayed transparent. \- When you place the mouse cursor over a pattern, the pattern is highlighted in its original color. \- A topology can only be created in one pattern at a time. 3. Click on the highlighted pattern to add a topology point. \- Topology can be created in both 2D and 3D windows. ** Creating Face** \- When creating Topology lines, the Topology face is created if it is a closed shape. \- Topology faces are created only on shapes with 3 or 4 points. \- To create an open shape, double click to finish creating. **Cancel point creation** \- Cancel one by one: Press Delete, Backspace Key on the keyboard. \- Cancel all points: Press ESC, Ctl + Z Key on the keyboard. **Loop Face Division** \- While selecting Topology tool, press Shift + Ctrl and mouse over to add Loop Face Division along the closest topology line. ### Editing ### Location 3D/2D Windows Tool Bar ▶ Edit topology tool ### Operation 1. Follow the path indicated in the Location above. 2. A pattern is highlighted in sky blue after selecting edit topology tool and place the mouse cursor over a pattern. 3. Select Topology point, line, face, and edit. ** Point/ Line multi-selection ** \- While pressing Shift Key on the keyboard and click to select multiple topology points/ lines. **2D point drag selection ** \- While pressing Ctrl key on the keyboard and drag to select multiple topology points. **Line loop selection ** \- Double click a topology line to loop select.** Delete Point/ Line/ Face** \- Press Delete key on the keyboard or right-click and select the delete menu to delete Point/ Line/ Face. **Extrude ** \- Select lines, press Shift + Ctrl and drag to Extrude. **Right-click popup menu ** \- Right-click on a point, line, face, pattern or background to access the popup menus. \- The menu that appears may vary depending on what is applied. **Delete** | Delete selected object. ---|--- **Merge** | Merge two or more points. **Merge All** | Merge all topology points by distance. Set the distance between topology points and click the apply button to merge. Click the close button to close the dialog. **Add Division (Current Pattern)** | Add division on a selected pattern. Adds one division level at a time. **Add All Division ** | Add division to entire Topology face. (right-click on the background to pop-up this menu) **Remesh (duplicate)** | Duplicate a new mesh based on created topology face. (Applied per pattern) **Remesh All (duplicate) ** | Duplicate a new mesh based on created topology face of the entire pattern. **Remesh (replace) ** | Delete an existing pattern and create a new mesh based on created topology face. (Applied per pattern) **Remesh All (replace) ** | Delete the entire pattern and create new mesh based on created topology face. **Show/Hide** Show/Hide created Topology from 3D Main menu ▶ Display ▶3D garment ▶ Show topology. **Topology Ghost Display/Snapping Based on The Sewing Lines (Above Ver.11)** When there are topology points at a pattern edge with a sewing line, you can find the ghosts of those points automatically displayed at the opposite sewing line. These ghost topology points help you snap any new topology you create across sewing relationships to exactly the same place as your existing topology. ### ### Patch Topology (Above Ver.11) ### Location 2D Window Tool Bar ▶ Patch Topology Tool ### Operation 1. Follow the Location above. 2. Select the Edit Patch Topology Tool, and a pop-up box appears, where you can adjust the number of subdivisions. Subdivisions | Adjust the number of subdivisions ---|--- Create | After all of the sections are closed, click the 'Create' button, and the patch lines will turn into topology faces. Clear | Delete all in-progress patch lines. 3. Create patch lines on a 2D pattern. \- Internal topology dash lines will appear divided into the preset number of subdivisions, if a patch section is either triangular or rectangular. \- You can change the number of subdivisions before closing a patch section. \- You can also change the number of subdivisions after closing a patch section by selecting the completed patch line.
content_description: This web page provides detailed instructions for using the Topology Tool and Patch Topology Tool to create and edit topology lines and faces in 2D and 3D patterns.

title: Retopology (ver. 12 & Above)
content: ### Objective Allow the user to draw topology lines onto existing patterns creating a new mesh with a lower polygon count and edge-loops optimized for animation. **Create Topology** **Location** 3D/2D Window Tool Bart ▶ Topology Tools **** **Operation** 1. Follow the path indicated in Location above. 2. When a Topology tool selected, patterns will be displayed as transparent. **→** When you place the mouse cursor over a pattern, the pattern is highlighted in its original color. **→** New topology can only be created on one pattern at a time. 3. Click on the highlighted pattern to add a topology point. **→** Topology can be created in both the 2D and 3D Windows, though we recommend using the 2D Window primarily. ** Creating Face** **→** When creating Topology lines, a Topology face is created if a closed shape is drawn. **→** Topology faces are created only on shapes with 3 or 4 points/sides. **→** To stop drawing Topology before closing a shape (leaving an open shape), double-click to finish. **Cancel point creation** **→** Cancel points one-by-one by pressing Delete/Backspace Key on the keyboard. **→** Cancel all points: Press ESC, Ctl + Z Key on the keyboard. **Add Division Loop** **→** While hovering over an edge with the Create Topology Tool, press Shift + Ctrl and click to add an edge loop across continuous faces. **Additional Operation (Above Ver.12)** **Cut Topology Faces →** Existing blue topology faces can be split by drawing new Topology Points/Edges across them.** →** If cut faces result in Ngons, any blue topology faces with more than 4 sides will be highlighted in orange. **Edit Topology** **Location** 3D/2D Windows Tool Bar▶ Edit Topology Tool **Operation** 1. Follow the path indicated in the Location above. 2. Existing topology is highlighted in sky blue after selecting the Edit Topology Tool and 3. Place the mouse cursor over a pattern with existing topology. 4. Select a Topology point, line, or face, and edit it by holding and moving it, or deleting it with the Delete Key. ** Point/ Line** **/ Face ****multi-selection ****→** While holding the Shift or the Ctrl Key, click on multiple topology points/lines one at a time to add them to a selection. **2D point drag selection ****→** While pressing Ctrl key on the keyboard and drag to select multiple topology points. **Line loop selection ****→** Double click a topology line to loop select.** Delete Point/ Line/ Face** **→** Press Delete key on the keyboard or right-click and select the delete menu to delete Point/ Line/ Face.** ** **Extrude ****→** Select lines, press Shift + Ctrl and drag to Extrude. **Right-click popup menu ****→** Right-click on a point, line, face, pattern or background to access the popup menus. **→** The menu that appears may vary depending on what is applied. Delete | Delete selected object. ---|--- Show Topology Only (3D) | Display only the topology, excluding garments or other objects. Show All | Unhide everything in the scene in 3D window. Merge | Merge two or more points. Merge All | Merge all topology points by distance. Set the distance between topology points and click the apply button to merge. Click the close button to close the dialog. Add Division (Current Pattern) | Add division on a selected pattern. Adds one division level at a time. Add All Division | Add division to entire Topology face. (right-click on the background to pop-up this menu) Remesh (duplicate) Convert (Duplicate) (ver. 2024.0) | Duplicate a new mesh based on created topology face. (Applied per pattern) Remesh All (duplicate) Convert All (Duplicate) (ver. 2024.0) | Duplicate a new mesh based on created topology face of the entire pattern. Remesh (replace) Convert (Replace) (ver. 2024.0) | Delete an existing pattern and create a new mesh based on created topology face. (Applied per pattern) Remesh All (replace) Convert All (Replace) (ver. 2024.0) | Delete the entire pattern and create new mesh based on created topology face. ** Show/ Hide** **→** Show/ Hide created Topology from 3D Main menu ▶ Display ▶3D garment ▶ Show topology. **Topology Ghost Display/Snapping Based on The Sewing Lines (Above Ver.11) ****→** When Topology Points meet pattern edges with a sewing line, you can find the ghosts of those points automatically displayed at the opposite sewing relationship.** ****→** These ghost Topology Points help you snap any new topology you create across sewing relationships to exactly the same place as the existing topology on patterns across the seam. **Additional Operation (Above Ver.12)** **Topology Ghost Display/Snapping across Sewing Relationships for Internal Lines ****→** When Topology Points meet Internal Lines with a sewing line, you can find the ghosts of those points automatically displayed at the opposite sewing relationship. **Drag Select Topology Points ** → Click outside of an area of blue topology and drag across it to select multiple Topology Points at once.** **→ Click and hold the 'Shift' Key, then click and drag over an additional area of blue topology to add Topology Points to an existing selection. **Drag Deselect Topology Points ** → Click and hold the 'Control' Key, then click and drag over an existing selection of Topology Points to remove Topology Points from that selection. **Patch Topology** **Location** 2D Window Tool Bar ▶ Patch Topology Tool **Operation(Above Ver.11)** 1. Navigate to the interface/menu Location above. 2. Select the 'Patch Topology' Tool, and a pop-up box will appear where you can adjust the number of subdivisions for an edge. Subdivisions | Adjust the number of edge subdivisions ---|--- Patch Style (ver. 2024.1) | Grid | Grid is the legacy algorithm which obtains more linear results. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438108949529)![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438125656473)![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438080407961) Uniform | A new algorithm which obtains results with more natural flow and smaller size differences. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438080642073)![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438094654617) Create | After the patch shape is closed, click the 'Create' button, and the patch lines will turn into topology faces. Clear | Delete all in-progress patch lines. 3. Create patch lines on a 2D pattern. **→** Internal topology will appear divided into the preset number of subdivisions along edges, if a a closed patch section is either triangular or rectangular. **→** You can change the number of subdivisions for the next edge while a Topology Patch is in progress (before the patch shape is closed). **→** You can also change the number of subdivisions after closing a patch section (but before clicking 'Create') by selecting the completed patch edge and changing the number in the 'Subdivisions' field. **Additional Operation (Above Ver.12)** **Snap Patch Topology to Internal Shapes/Lines** **→** Patch Topology edges will snap to both external and internal pattern lines and curve points. **Snap Patch Topology to Convex Curves** **→** Patch Topology edges will now snap to both concave and convex curves. **→** If the curvature of an edge is too extreme for a patch to be created, add one or several curve points along the curved edge with the 'Add Point/Split Line' tool to divide the curve into sections with less extreme curvature. **Evaluate Patch Validity at Creation** **→** After closing a Topology Patch and clicking 'Create', if the drawn patch would create overlapping geometry, an error window pop-up will be raised - return to the Patch Topology tool and update the patch as necessary to avoid overlapping edges/vertices. **→** If the drawn patch would not result in overlapping geometry, the Topology Patch will be created and displayed in blue. ※ Note: * The algorithm for patch topology has been improved, resulting in a more efficient mesh. (ver. 2024.0) * In the case of a square with the same number of points on each side, the results for both Grid and Uniform patch styles are the same. (ver. 2024.1)
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on utilizing the Topology Tools to create and edit optimized mesh structures for efficient animation in both 2D and 3D environments.

title: Apply Fabric
content: ### Objective Apply Fabrics (.zfab) to Patterns. ### Operation #### Apply from Property Editor 1. Click on a Pattern, and choose a Fabric to apply from the Fabric menu in the Property Editor. → The selected Fabric is now being applied to the selected Pattern accordingly. ※ Note: * Only Fabrics in the Fabric tab are being displayed in the corresponding Fabric menu. #### Assign to Selected Pattern 1. Select a Pattern. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser ▶ Fabric ▶ Assign to Selected Patterns → The selected Fabric is now being applied to the selected Pattern accordingly. #### Assign to New Fabric 1. Select a Pattern. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser ▶ Fabric ▶ Assign to New Fabric Right-click Pattern Pop-up Menu ▶ Assign to New Fabric → The new Fabric is now being applied to the selected Pattern and simultaneously added on the Fabric tab. #### Apply from Folder 1. With Window File Search, open a folder where the Fabric files are being stored. 2. Drag and drop a desired Fabric onto a pattern in 2D or 3D window. → The selected Pattern is now being applied to the selected Pattern and simultaneously added on the Fabric tab. 3. Or, drag and drop Fabric files onto Fabric tab of the Object Browser. → In case of drag-and-dropping onto Fabric item, the previous Fabric style gets replaced. → In case of drag-and-dropping onto the empty space, the Fabric gets added in the list. #### Apply from Library Window 1. Open a folder where the Fabric files are being stored from the Library window. 2. Drag and drop a desired Fabric onto a Pattern in 2D or 3D window. → The selected Pattern is now being applied to the selected Pattern and simultaneously added on the Fabric List window. 3. Drag and drop fabric files onto Fabric tab of the Object Browser: → In case of drag-and-dropping onto Fabric item, the previous item gets replaced. → In case of drag-and-dropping onto the empty space, the Fabric gets added in the list. #### Apply from Fabric Tab 1. Drag and drop a desired Fabric onto a Pattern in 2D or 3D window. → The selected Pattern is now being applied to the selected Pattern.
content_description: This web page provides step-by-step instructions for applying Fabrics (.zfab) to Patterns using various methods within the software.

title: Styleline Editing
content: ### Objective Quickly shape patterns in the 3D Window, without the need for previous experience in pattern making. * * * ### Location Main Menu ▶ 3D Garment ▶ Edit Styleline Tools 3D Window ▶ Edit Styleline Tool Dropdown Menu **** ### Operation 1. Load a garment into a scene with an Avatar. 2. Navigate the tool/menu indicated above under "Location". 3. Select a Styleline Editing Tool: Edit Styleline | Select an edit point or place on a curve to skew the pattern shape dynamically. ---|--- Scale Styleline | Select a pattern edge and scale it as a whole. Move Styleline | Select a pattern edge and move it as singular unit which does not skew. Draw Styleline | Draw a new Styleline onto a pattern in the 3D Window. 1. Click on an edge or corner of a pattern piece to begin drawing a new Styleline across it. 2. Click on in the center of the pattern piece to shape the Styleline. 3. Click on another edge or corner of the pattern piece to complete the new Styleline. 4. Manipulate the new Styleline with any of the other Styleline tools. 4. Alter the garment accordingly and watch the patterns update immediately in both the 3D Window and 2D Pattern Window.
content_description: Easily create and modify garment patterns in the 3D Window with intuitive tools designed for users of any skill level.

title: ZIPPER: Unzip/ Zip Zippers
content: ### Objective Zip or unzip Zippers as needed. ### Location 3D Toolbar ▶ Select/Move ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Toolbar ▶ Select/Move 2. Click & drag on the Zipper Slider. → The selected Slider is highlighted in yellow. 3. Continue to drag the Slider. → The Slider follows and moves along with the cursor. → A preview of the new Slider position appears. 4. Release the mouse to the desired position. → The Zipper Slider is moved to the new location. 5. Activate the Simulate tool. → The Zipper simulates and zips/unzips based on the new location.

title: Requesting Network Software License activation - First Time installation (Linux OS)
content: **[Software License Key for Network Offline] Generate a C2V for First Time Installation - Linux OS** **1\. Install a Run-time Environment on your Linux server following by steps below (step1, step2)** **Step 1.** Unzip aksusbd-8.31.1.tar ([aksusbd-8.31.1](https://s3.amazonaws.com/s3.md.web.upload/newmdweb/helpcenter/installer/aksusbd-8.31.1.tar) **Download**) **Step 2.** As root, open a terminal window and enter the command: **./dinst** Once you are completed with steps above(step1, step2), you’re ready to generate a C2V file for the first time installation of an SL key. **Step 3.** Open a web browser and navigate to ([ACC Page](http://localhost:1947)) **Step 4.** Click on the “Fingerprint” button to create a C2V file. ![pasted_image_0.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438535259545) **Step 5.** Submit your C2V file to this [**page**](https://marvelousdesigner.com/teamconsole/keyupdate/1) (Login with company account is required). If you experience any difficulties, please contact us via support@marvelousdesigner.com **Step 6.** Please refer below to complete a V2C key update. **[Applying a V2C on the server]** 1\. Download the V2C file sent to you from Marvelous Designer Support Team. 2\. Click on the link below to access the ACC Page, then select “Update/Attach” in Options on the left. ([Click here to link ACC Page](http://localhost:1947/_int_/ACC_help_index.html)) ![v2c_application_1.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438535435289) 3\. Click “Choose File” to find and select the downloaded V2C file. ![v2c_application_2.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438529660697) 4\. Click “Apply File”. 5\. If the update is successful, the following message will be printed. ![v2c_application_3.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438535827353) **[Double checking an updated License Key]** If the License Key Update process is successfully completed, you will be able to double check by following the steps below. 1\. Open a web browser and navigate to [ACC Page](http://localhost:1947/_int_/ACC_help_index.html) 2\. Click Features once you see the key info. ![v2c_application_4.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438530123161) 3\. Make sure the number in the red box has been changed to the correct number. ![v2c_application_5.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438536362905)
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for generating a C2V file and updating a software license key for first-time installation on a Linux server operating offline.

title: 3D (Above ver4.2.0)
content: ### Objective Change the default settings of the software in User Settings. Designated settings will become the default after the program is restarted. Shortcut keys, menus, graphics options, view controls, default files, font settings, and other miscellaneous properties can be set in User Settings. In the 3D section, configure settings related to 3D features. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Settings ▶ User Settings ▶ 3D Main Menu ▶ Settings/Preferences ▶ Preferences ▶ 3D (ver 11) ### Operation 1. Adjust the settings below as needed: Mesh | Set the default mesh setting to Triangle or Quad. ---|--- Arrangement | Default Arrangement Shape Type | Arrange the pattern as curved or flat around the bounding volume of the Avatar when placing patterns around the avatar with arrangement points. Default Arrangement Point Size | Modify the default arrangement point size (radius). For smaller avatars, the default arrangement point size may hinder pattern arrangement, so decrease the size of the arrangement points for efficient pattern arrangement. Sync Fold Arrangement Angle | When using the Fold Arrangement tool, change the selected Internal Line or Pattern Outline's Fold Angle accordingly (ver4.2.0). Gizmo | Unified Gizmo: Select, move, and rotate with a single Gizmo tool. Divided Gizmo: Select (Q), Move (W), Rotate (E) are divided into separate Gizmo tools. The Divided Gizmo tool automatically reassigns the Pin shortcut key from W to P on the keyboard. If P is already in use as a shortcut key, a shortcut key will not be applied to Pin (ver2.5.0).
content_description: Customize your software experience by adjusting default settings in User Settings, including 3D features, shortcut keys, and arrangement options for optimal performance.

content: ### Objective Change the default settings of the software menu according to user preference in User Settings. Upon restarting, the user settings of the software becomes the default settings. In CLOSET section, configure login settings necessary to use CLOSET related features (File Share and CLOSET Render). ### Location Main Menu ▶ Setting ▶ User Setting ▶ CLOSET Main Menu ▶ Settings/Preferences ▶ Preferences ▶ CLOSET (ver 11) ### Operation 1. When this option is on, please type in corresponding ID and PW. ---|---

title: Fabric Texture Normal Map
content: ### Objective Apply Normal Maps to express bumpy surfaces such as twill, corduroy, and leather. ### Location Object Browser ▶ Fabric Tab ▶ Fabric Item ▶ Property Editor ▶ Material ▶ Normal Map ### Operation #### Fabric Normal Map 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser ▶ Fabric Tab ▶ Fabric Item ▶ Property Editor ▶ Material ▶ Normal Map → An intensity value range of -10 to 10 can be adjusted with the scrollbar or entered directly. → Depending on the normal map applied, the visual depth will change as you scroll from negative to positive values. #### Apply Fabric Normal Map Image 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser ▶ Fabric Tab ▶ Fabric Item ▶ Property Editor ▶ Material ▶ Normal Map 2. Click on Open button. 3. Select and load the desired texture image file. → The selected image is now applied. ※ Note : * Although a Normal Map is automatically generated for Fabric textures, it is recommended to use third party solutions to generate more distinctive normal map effects. This feature can also be used to overlay a different texture above the existing texture. The normal map image size can also be adjusted via: Fabric Property Editor ▶ Material ▶ Texture Transformation. * Drag and drop an image file directly from the file browser to the Open icon next to the Normal Map menu in the Property Editor (ver4.0.0). * Drag and drop an image file directly from the file browser to an object in the program, then select the correct map: texture, normal, specular (ver4.0.0).
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on applying normal maps to enhance the visual depth of various fabric surfaces, such as twill, corduroy, and leather, using the Object Browser and Property Editor tools.

title: HASP Error Message
content: ## Communication error between local and remote Sentinel HASP License Managers (H0040) ### **Cause of Error** The Server and Client PCs are unable to communicate with each other. ### **Solution** 1\. Type 'services.msc' in the Run window. ![image_1.jpeg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438505080345) 2\. In the Service window that follows, check whether or not the status of the ‘Sentinel LDK License Manager’ is ‘Running’. * If the status is not ‘Running’, right-click and select Start. If the status is ‘Started’, right-click and select Restart. Reboot. ![Image_2.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438476878361) 3\. If this does not solve the problem, check both versions of the Server and Client PC’s HASP Drivers. Make sure both versions are the same. You are able to check the version under Diagnostics. ![Image_3.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438477089561) 4\. If this does not work, ask your Network Administrator to confirm the Port communication status between the Server and Client. Check whether the 1947 Port is being used by another program. ## ## Feature not found (H0031) ### **Cause of Error** Despite the dongle key has been recognized, the Feature ID of the program and the Feature ID of the dongle key are different. (This occurs when the wrong version of Marvelous Deisnger is installed - i.e. installed the Stand-Alone version for a Network dongle key, and vice versa) ### **Solution** Make sure the correct version of Marvelous Designer is installed. ex> Purchased the Network version, but used the Stand-Alone version's installer. -> Re-install Marvelous Designer using the Network version's installer. ## ## Sentinel HASP key not found (H0007) ### **Cause of Error** * When the HASP Key is not plugged into the PC. * Network Version only: the Client PC does not recognize the Server PC that the dongle key is connected to. * When the HASP Key is recognized, but the Sentinel License Manager service fails to start properly. ### **Solution** Make sure the HASP is connected to the PC. 1. Check the red light of the HASP Key. It should light up when plugged in to the PC. 2. Check whether or not the HASP Key shows up in the [ACC page](http://localhost:1947/_int_/ACC_help_index.html) (refer to the image below) ![Image_4.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438505581465) 3. If the red light or the ACC page does not look equal to the image above, refer to the following manual, reinstall the Sentinel HASP Driver. **[HASP Driver Installation](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358254274585)** ## ## Too many concurrent users (H0038) ### **Cause of Error** When the number of users connected to the program exceeds the maximum allowed number of users. ex> If the maximum number of users (the number of purchased licenses) is 2, and 3 users try to log-in, the last person to attempt a connection will receive an error message. ### **Solution** Check the number of current users via the link below. Connect when one of the current users exit the program. **[ACC Page](http://localhost:1947/_int_/ACC_help_index.html)** Click Sentinel Keys, on the left. When the Key shows up as the image above, click Sessions, on the right. The following page should display the current user(s). Connect when one of the current users exits the program. If any unauthorized user is connected, click the Disconnect button on the right to log the person out of the program. ## ## Unable to access Sentinel HASP Run-time Environment(H0033) ### **Cause of Error** The HASP Driver has not been properly installed on the PC, or the Driver is damaged. To confirm whether it is properly installed, enter [http://localhost:1947](http://localhost:1947/_int_/ACC_help_index.html) or [http://127.0.0.1:1947](http://127.0.0.1:1947/_int_/ACC_help_index.html) into your web browser, or click on the following link ( [ACC Page](http://127.0.0.1:1947/_int_/ACC_help_index.html) ). If the following page does not look equal to the image below, there is a problem with the Sentinel HASP Driver. ### ![Image_5.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438477525529) **Solution** Refer to the following manual and reinstall the HASP Driver. **[HASP Driver Installation](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358254274585)**
content_description: This web page provides troubleshooting solutions for common Sentinel HASP License Manager errors to ensure seamless software operation and licensing compliance.
